description: Test suite for usage accumulator functions in a module related to usage metrics, including creation, merging, normalization, and resolution of usage data.

methods.name: createUsageAccumulator
methods.description: Creates a new usage accumulator object.

methods.name: mergeUsageIntoAccumulator
methods.description: Merges usage data into the accumulator, updating totals and last call snapshot.

methods.name: resolveLastCallUsage
methods.description: Resolves and returns the last call's usage data, preferring raw assistant usage if available.

methods.name: toLastCallUsage
methods.description: Returns the snapshot of the most recent call from the accumulator.

methods.name: toNormalizedUsage
methods.description: Returns the accumulated usage data formatted for billing, excluding zero fields.
